value.rationale: The channel inverse list of whole-block doubling has a complete structural classification and exact all-length population law. This exposes its complete one-insertion confusability graph, yielding exact maximum correction subcode cardinalities and counts of all optimizers through rotation orbits. The sharp expurgation result is useful for a natural rate-one-half block-copy synchronization encoder rather than a routine reparameterization of unrestricted insertion bounds.
